regions.today: Mainly cloudy this evening with scattered outbreaks of rain moving in from the west, possibly heavy in places. Moderate to fresh south to southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy to start with patchy rain, then clearer spells following later in the night. A cooler night than of late with lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees, with light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Bright and breezy tomorrow with sunny spells and well scattered passing showers. A fresher day with highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees, with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds, easing later in the day.
